name: Play Friends: Party Games
detailed_description:
🎉 Get Ready for Non-Stop Party Fun!

Turn any gathering into an instant party! Play Friends - Party Games is a fast, fun, and easy-to-learn multiplayer game where friends and family can laugh, compete, and play together—anytime, anywhere!

🔥 Addictive Party Games 🔥

Jump into six thrilling mini-games, each offering a unique mix of skill, strategy, and fun:

  • Knockout – Push, dodge, and survive! Stay on the platform while sending your rivals flying!

  • Animatch – Reflexes win the round! Spot and match the correct character before your opponents!

  • Punchline – A battle of wits! Come up with the funniest response and claim victory!

  • Ship Shapes – Draw fast, think faster! Complete patterns before the ship sinks!

  • Word Connect – Teamwork is key! Solve the challenge grid together—think fast, win together!

🎮 Play with your Phone as a Controller

No extra controllers needed! Everyone joins the game using their own smartphone with Play Friends - Play Friends, available for free on iOS and Android.

✅ Host matches on PC, tablet, or TV.
✅ Players join instantly by scanning a QR code or entering a room code.
✅ Perfect for parties and get-togethers!

📺 Remote Play with Friends

Not in the same place? No problem! Use Discord, Steam Broadcast, or any streaming platform to share your screen and play with friends no matter where they are!

🎥 Stream your game in real-time.
📱 Friends join instantly from their phone.

🌍 Supported Languages

Currently available in:

✅ English
✅ Portuguese (Brazil)
✅ Spanish (Latam)

More languages coming soon! Let us know your preferred language.

🎉 Join Our Community

Get involved with other players, suggest new mini-games, and stay up-to-date with future updates by joining our Discord server.

💖 Wishlist Now & Support Us!

Help us bring the party to even more players! Add Play Friends - Party Games to your Steam Wishlist and stay tuned for new mini-games and exciting updates!

🛒 Add Play Friends - Party Games to your Steam Wishlist today!

🎈 Try It for Free—Endless Party Fun Awaits!

Try it for FREE and bring the fun anywhere! Play Friends - Party Games is the perfect party starter, whether you're playing on the couch with friends or connecting remotely. Laugh, create chaos, and make epic memories! 🚀🎉

short_description: A shared-screen Party Game where up to 8 players use their phones as controllers to play short, creative mini-games. Whether local or remote, players battle, draw, match, and laugh through quick challenges, with no downloads or complex setups.
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Spanish - Latin America*, Spanish - Spain*, Indonesian*, Japanese*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Thai*, Traditional Chinese*, Ukrainian*, Vietnamese*, Filipino*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
